**Flow 10 — sorting.** A **Sort** control now sits on the right, above the list.
1. It starts on **Date added — newest first** (matching what you approved for saving).
2. Open the dropdown and choose **Date added — oldest first** — the list flips so your earliest saves are at the top.
3. Choose **Title — A to Z**, then **Z to A** — the list reorders alphabetically by title.
4. Your chosen sort **stays applied while you search or switch views**, so a filtered result is ordered the same way.
